title: Sky Orchestrator configuration
description: Every tunable, once (FR-OPS-03, IR-CFG). Each consumer's own configuration file holds exactly the keys that list it in x-consumers, all of them required, and nothing else (ADR-0019). x-unit, x-consumers and x-safety are annotations; a validator ignores them.

max_height_m.description: Highest height above the takeoff point. 120 m is the EU open-category ceiling.

geofence_center.description: Centre of the geofence, WGS84. Has no default: a default geofence centre is a geofence somewhere the aircraft is not (IR-CFG-02).

geofence_radius_m.description: Radius of the geofence around geofence_center.

max_home_distance_m.description: Furthest horizontal distance from the home point.

max_transit_m.description: Longest transit from the takeoff position to the wayline start (FR-WAY-10).

max_total_distance_m.description: Longest route a wayline may fly, from the reference point through every waypoint (FR-WAY-06). Checked at ingest; the application bounds each leg and the distance from home instead.

clock_offset_warn_ms.description: Clock offset against so-bridge that raises a preflight warning (FR-BRG-13).

max_horizontal_speed_ms.description: Fastest horizontal speed. 15 m/s is the SDK's own virtual-stick ceiling.

waypoint_tolerance_h_m.description: Horizontal distance at which a waypoint counts as reached.

waypoint_tolerance_v_m.description: Vertical distance at which a waypoint counts as reached.

min_battery_start_pct.description: Lowest battery that may start a mission. Must exceed min_battery_rth_pct.

min_battery_rth_pct.description: Below this the aircraft returns home whatever the mission is doing (FR-SAF-03). Must exceed min_battery_land_pct.

min_battery_land_pct.description: Below this the aircraft lands where it is (FR-SAF-03).

min_satellites.description: Fewest satellites for a mission start, and for an automatic landing confirmation (FR-SAF-16).

min_gps_level.description: Lowest GPS signal level on DJI's 0 to 5 scale.

stick_watchdog_ms.description: Guidance silence after which the aircraft is commanded to zero velocity (FR-SAF-02). Must be below stick_failsafe_ms, and at least two guidance periods, or it trips between two ordinary commands.

stick_failsafe_ms.description: Guidance silence after which virtual stick is released and the aircraft returns home (FR-SAF-02).

envelope_reaction_ms.description: Longest time from a breach or a loss of authority to the reaction (FR-SAF-01, FR-SAF-09). While the application holds control, aircraft state older than this no longer counts: nothing can be judged within the bound on older news.

arming_ttl_s.description: How long an operator arming stays valid (FR-SAF-07).

stick_takeover_threshold.description: Stick deflection that counts as the pilot taking over (FR-SAF-10).

stick_takeover_dwell_ms.description: How long the deflection must last before control is released (FR-SAF-10).

home_point_tolerance_m.description: Largest distance between the set home point and the takeoff position (FR-SAF-14).

landing_auto_confirm_radius_m.description: Radius around the home point and the takeoff position inside which a landing may be confirmed automatically (FR-SAF-16).

landing_confirm_wait_s.description: Wait with no stick input before an automatic landing confirmation (FR-SAF-16).

telemetry_stale_after_ms.description: Silence after which a telemetry field is stale and never used or published as live (FR-TEL-05). In so-msdk-v4 it is also the oldest a virtual-stick answer may be, and how long acquiring control may wait, so it may not exceed stick_failsafe_ms.

bridge_telemetry_hz.description: Telemetry rate on the bridge WebSocket (FR-BRG-04).

bridge_heartbeat_timeout_ms.description: Heartbeat silence that counts as bridge link loss (FR-BRG-04, FR-SAF-04).

capture_max_bytes.description: Largest rolling capture or flight record before the oldest files go (IR-CAP).

device_offline_timeout_s.description: Silence after which the aircraft is reported offline (FR-DEV-03). so-gateway applies it to so-fleet itself: a so-fleet that stops speaking without disconnecting cannot leave the aircraft listed online.

presign_ttl_s.description: Lifetime of a presigned wayline URL (FR-WAY-05).

simulator_mode.description: Server half of the two keys that leave simulator mode (NFR-SAF-03). The other half is a confirmation on the phone.

cloud_role.description: Whether Sky Orchestrator also plays the cloud, or a client does (ADR-0010). so-wayline keeps files in the object store under builtin, and on its own volume under external, where there is no store (ADR-0029).

dock_identity.description: The emulated dock's identity on the Cloud API surface (FR-DEV-04, IR-DEV): serial number, DJI's product enumeration and firmware string. Has no default: a default serial number is a device that does not exist, and regenerating one breaks every client's device history (IR-DEV-01). A DJI Dock 2 is domain 3, type 2, sub_type 0.

aircraft_identity.description: The aircraft's identity on the Cloud API surface (FR-DEV-04, IR-DEV): serial number, DJI's product enumeration and firmware string. Has no default: a default serial number is a device that does not exist, and regenerating one breaks every client's device history (IR-DEV-01). The Dock 2's Matrice 3D is domain 0, type 91, sub_type 0, which is what a client expects behind a Dock 2; the Mavic Air 2 that actually flies has no Cloud API identity of its own.
